Spiced Cream Cheese Frosting
By: BigFatBaker
Published: Saturday, October 23, 2010 - 9:11pm

Ingredients




1 block cream cheese, room temperature
1 stick butter, softened
2 cups powdered sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon nutmeg
1/4 teaspoon ginger
1/4 teaspoon cardamom

Preparation

1 Beat together the cream cheese and butter until smooth. 2 Add the powdered sugar little by little, to fully incorporate it. 3 Add in the spices and vanilla, mix well. 4 If you are going to make this for a whoopie pie filling, fold in 7 oz marshmallow fluff by hand only until it is just mixed.
